concept_theme_dark: liberusoftware/theme-dark is a public theme package documented in Theme Architecture, inheriting semantic design tokens from theme-base.
concept_theme_validate_command: theme:validate / theme:cache / theme:clear are Artisan commands for validating and managing the theme system's cache, documented in Theme Architecture and the Theme System Guide.
concept_translation_caching: Translation caching stores machine-translation results to reduce repeated calls, documented alongside search API rate limiting and the MyMemory TranslationService.
concept_triage_labels: Canonical triage labels are the standard GitHub issue labels used for triage, defined in docs/agents/triage-labels.md.
concept_upgrade_blockers: Known upgrade blockers lists dependency version constraints (e.g. spatie/laravel-permission v8, spiral/roadrunner-http v4) preventing certain package upgrades, per CLAUDE.md.
concept_users_table_filters: Users table filters and badges are Filament table UI features for the admin user-management enhancement, documented in the Quick Reference Guide.
concept_verification_gates: Foundation verification gates are the CI/CLI checks (module:validate, theme:validate, foundation:doctor) that enforce the foundation compliance boundaries.
concept_version_fields_load_bearing: composer.json version fields are load-bearing documents that a package's declared version drives tooling behavior and must not be treated as cosmetic, per a migration handoff.
concept_wayfinder_map: The Wayfinder map and child tickets is a GitHub issue structure (rooted at issue #612) used to organize and track related work items in the issue tracker.
concerns_searchable: Searchable.php is a trait in the search module providing scopeSearch() and searchableColumns() to make Eloquent models full-text searchable.
config_session: config/session.php is the host's Laravel session configuration file controlling session driver, lifetime, and cookie settings.
config_socialstream: config/socialstream.php configures bursteri/socialstream, the package providing OAuth social login integration for the host application.
context_localecontext_localecontext: LocaleContext is a class in localization-core that carries resolved locale state, exposing a payload() method for consumers.
contracts_metrics: Metrics.php defines the observability module's Metrics contract with increment() and observe() methods for recording application metrics.
contracts_organizationactor: OrganizationActor.php defines the organizations-teams contract with belongsToTeam() and ownsTeam() methods that the host User model implements.
contracts_registrationpolicy: RegistrationPolicy.php defines the identity-core contract with permitsSelfRegistration() and requiresInvitation() methods governing user registration rules.
controllers_agencycontroller: AgencyController.php is the API controller in real-estate-core-api handling HTTP requests for Agency resources.
controllers_agencycontroller_agencycontr: .rules() returns the validation rules used by AgencyController's store() and update() actions.
controllers_searchcontroller_searchcontr: .all() is a SearchController method in search-api that runs a search across all supported entity types.
.projectUsers() is a SearchController method that formats/projects user search results for the API response.
.users() is a SearchController endpoint method that searches users specifically, validating user-scoped filters.
controllers_territorycontroller: TerritoryController.php is the API controller in real-estate-core-api handling HTTP requests for Territory resources.
controllers_territorycontroller_territor: .rules() returns the validation rules used by TerritoryController's store() and update() actions.
cursor_mcp: .cursor/mcp.json configures MCP servers (including laravel-boost and lerd) available to the Cursor editor for this project.
delivery_phase_3: Delivery phase 3 covers lettings, property management, accounting, and owner/tenant portals in the real estate module's three-phase delivery plan.
doc_copilot_instructions: .github/copilot-instructions.md provides GitHub Copilot with project-specific guidance, referencing the lerd local PHP development environment.
doc_foundation_compliance: Foundation Compliance (docs/FOUNDATION_COMPLIANCE.md) documents the composition host's foundation boundaries and verification gates.
doc_foundation_module_matrix: Foundation module implementation matrix (docs/FOUNDATION_MODULE_MATRIX.md) maps foundation capabilities to the packages implementing them.
doc_junie_guidelines: .junie/guidelines.md provides the Junie AI assistant with project-specific instructions, referencing the lerd development environment.

domain_mediaanddocumentscapabilitydefini: MediaAndDocumentsCapabilityDefinition.php is the PHP source file defining the real-estate-media-and-documents module's capability definition in its Domain layer.
domain_offerscapabilitydefinition: OffersCapabilityDefinition.php is the PHP source file defining the real-estate-offers module's capability definition in its Domain layer.
domain_partiescapabilitydefinition: PartiesCapabilityDefinition.php is the PHP source file defining the real-estate-parties module's capability definition in its Domain layer.
